details.title: Netty HttpPostRequestDecoder can OOM
details.description: Netty before 4.1.108.Final allows an out-of-memory condition. Fixed in 4.1.108.Final and later.

details.title: Jetty HTTP/2 denial of service
details.description: Eclipse Jetty HTTP/2 server implementation has a denial of service vulnerability. No specific fixed version identified in advisory.

details.title: PostgreSQL JDBC SQL injection via line comment generation
details.description: pgjdbc before 42.6.1 and 42.7.2 allows SQL injection via line comment generation. Upgrade to 42.6.1 or 42.7.2 to fix.
